description: This file is a JavaScript test script for the Thunder Plugin OCIContainer, which tests container lifecycle operations via WebSocket RPC calls, including registration, start, pause, resume, execute command, stop, and unregistration, with event handling and response validation.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message with a timestamp relative to startTime.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection to the RPC server.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Sends a JSON-RPC request over WebSocket and waits for the response, with optional response checking and timeout.

methods.name: waitEvent
methods.description: Waits for a specific event message from the WebSocket, with optional timeout and response check.
